name: sme-fused-a-panel-unroll2
hypothesis: Start from existing-sme, the strongest measured source. Transpose one 2VL-row A panel, then reuse it across all B column blocks in the same streaming function. This reduces the active A scratch footprint and removes one streaming transition. Keep B unpacked because packing both inputs regressed in two repeats. Unroll the product loop by two and move second-vector offsets outside it. This candidate is untested; the supplied measurements do not establish the target throughput.
